mb_sh.out:
#!/bin/bash
# V10701-A5 — MB advanced lane daily driver (parity with MN/MT).
# Runs AFTER MB official predict (~17:42) and BEFORE MB result (~18:32) so the
# advanced engine sees today's predictions but stays pre-result (causal-safe).
# Shadow-only: never writes final_bundles / predictions / model_daily_eval /
# lottery_results. Each sub-step has its own official-tables guard.
cd /root/Lottery_AI_Test/web/backend || exit 1
PY=/root/Lottery_AI_Test/venv/bin/python3
TODAY=$($PY -c "from vn_timezone import vn_now; print(vn_now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d'))" 2>/dev/null || date +%F)
echo "=== $(date -Is) MB advanced lane daily date=$TODAY ==="
# V10701-M-readiness: tạo mb_experimental_preview_shadow legacy (7 exp) TRƯỚC để card MB
# "Method trải nghiệm" đầy đủ + endpoint MB không fallback về ngày cũ (chống lỗi 04/06).
$PY _materialize_mb_experimental_preview_shadow.py --date "$TODAY" --json
$PY _materialize_experimental_preview_shadow.py --date "$TODAY" --region MB --json
$PY _du_doan_test_engine.py --date "$TODAY" --region MB --mode REALTIME_AVAILABLE_ONLY
$PY _v10679_full_pool_d_w06_lane.py --region MB --date "$TODAY"
$PY _v10680_topk_strength_lane.py --region MB --date "$TODAY"
echo "=== $(date -Is) MB advanced lane daily DONE ==="
